title: Remote viewing used to trade silver futures
summary: Hal Puthoff tells of Remote viewing used to trade silver futures, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Hal Puthoff, speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, says he took part in using remote viewing, the attempt to sense distant or hidden things with the mind alone, to bet on silver futures, which are wagers on where the price of silver will go. He says that when they checked the next day, they were right about 70 percent of the time instead of the 50 percent you would expect from guessing, which, if true, would suggest the mind can reach information it should not have.
